results.title: Divisional Operations Manager- Road Transport
results.description: 📢📢📢 We are looking for a Divisional Operations Manager- Road Transport (RT) Operations, based in Riyadh. JOB PURPOSE: To lead and oversee the overall RT operations across assigned locations, ensuring safe, efficient, reliable, and cost-effective operations through optimum fleet and manpower utilization, effective fleet availability and maintenance coordination, fuel and tyre cost control, strong safety culture, customer satisfaction, operational visibility, and continuous improvement, while achieving business objectives and agreed KPIs. To ensure that safety and environmental aspects of Sustainability are embedded into the business strategy and daily operations. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 1. Fleet Utilization & Availability Monitor fleet utilization on a daily basis and identify opportunities for improvement. Conduct daily fleet availability checks and coordinate with Maintenance to minimize vehicle downtime. Monitor fleet running kilometres on daily basis and control unnecessary or excess running. 2. Driver Management & Utilization Monitor driver availability and utilization on a daily basis. Plan and manage driver scheduling to ensure optimum utilization and minimize idle time. Ensure adequate driver availability to meet daily customer requirements. 3. Fuel Management & Cost Reduction Monitor fuel mileage/consumption and implement actions to improve mileage. Investigate abnormal fuel consumption and take corrective action. Control unnecessary vehicle running and identify opportunities for fuel cost reduction. 4. Tyre Management Monitor tyre utilization, replacement and performance. Implement effective controls to maximize tyre life and reduce tyre-related costs. Coordinate with Maintenance for timely inspection and corrective action. 5. Safety & Compliance Drive a strong safety culture across the driver and RT Operations teams with hearts and minds approach. Monitor driver safety performance and ensure compliance with company safety standards. Take proactive action to address unsafe practices and recurring safety concerns. Conduct enroute spot checks and reporting. Conduct pre-loading and vehicle & integrity checks. Incident reporting and participation in Incident investigation. 6. Customer Management Maintain close coordination with customers regarding daily orders and operational requirements. Ensure timely follow-up and resolution of customer requirements and operational issues. Maintain strong customer relationships and improve service satisfaction. Increase the revenues by increased truck utilization. 7. Maintenance Coordination Work closely with the Maintenance team to improve fleet availability and reliability. Support initiatives to reduce maintenance costs and improve preventive maintenance practices. Monitor recurring vehicle issues and ensure appropriate corrective actions are implemented. 8. Continuous Improvement Identify and implement new initiatives to improve operational efficiency, productivity and cost effectiveness. Establish appropriate KPIs and provide management with clear visibility of operational performance. Continuously review processes and identify opportunities for improvement. 9. Overall RT Operations Management Take overall responsibility for RT Operations at the assigned location. Preparation of daily, weekly and monthly reports and sharing with the stakeholders Participation in customer engagements and BPR Ensure daily operations are properly planned, controlled and executed. Monitor operational performance and take timely corrective action where required. Ensure alignment between Operations, Drivers, Maintenance, Customers and Management. Follow-up for Customer payments

results.title: Service Manager – Commercial Vehicles
results.description: 🚛 Hiring: Service Manager – Commercial Vehicles | Kuwait We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established automotive and commercial vehicle organisation in Kuwait for an experienced Service Manager – Commercial Vehicles to lead its service and workshop operations. This is a senior operational role responsible for driving workshop performance, service quality, profitability, team productivity and customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities: • Manage the overall Commercial Vehicle Service & Workshop operation , ensuring efficient workflow and productivity. • Lead and manage service advisors, technicians, workshop personnel and support teams. • Monitor workshop productivity, utilisation, repair quality and turnaround times . • Ensure vehicles are completed and delivered on time while maintaining manufacturer and service standards. • Manage escalated customer issues and ensure effective resolution. • Monitor and improve service revenue, labour sales, parts consumption, warranty performance and workshop profitability . • Plan workshop manpower, tools, equipment and capacity according to business requirements. • Drive continuous improvement across workshop operations and customer service. Candidate Requirements: • Minimum 8–10 years' experience within automotive or commercial vehicle service/workshop operations. • Proven experience as a Service Manager, Workshop Manager or similar leadership role . • Strong preference for candidates with experience in commercial vehicles, trucks, buses or heavy-duty vehicles . • Strong knowledge of workshop operations, productivity and service KPIs. • Demonstrable experience managing and developing workshop/service teams. • Commercial understanding of service revenue, labour, parts, warranty and profitability. • Strong customer management and problem-solving skills. • Must currently be based in Kuwait and available for local recruitment. • Transferable Kuwait residency preferred. 📍 Location: Kuwait 🚛 Sector: Automotive / Commercial Vehicles 💼 Position: Service Manager – Commercial Vehicles If you have strong commercial vehicle workshop management experience and are currently based in Kuwait, please apply.

results.title: Sr. Manager Logistics Operations
results.description: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE? Lead Talabat Qatar’s overall supply ecosystem, ensuring a sustainable, high-quality, and high-performing rider base across the country. Develop and execute the overall supply growth and acquisition strategy aligned with business demand and market dynamics. Lead long-term supply forecasting and planning to ensure full coverage and service level adherence. Identify and launch new supply channels such as female riders, refugees, micro-financing, and e-bikes to diversify and sustain fleet growth. Manage the full lifecycle of 3PL partnerships, from selection and onboarding to performance management and contract renewals. Set clear KPIs and SLAs for 3PL partners, ensuring compliance, efficiency, and rider quality. Build and maintain strong strategic relationships with key 3PL partners to drive alignment and operational excellence. Lead and manage the on-ground operations team to ensure smooth daily operations, compliance, and service quality. Monitor and improve key operational KPIs including rider supply rate, EPH, order-on-time percentage, and churn rate. Implement standardized processes and digital tools to enhance control, visibility, and scalability across operations. Coach and develop a high-performing team of managers, seniors, and specialists across supply, 3PLs, and operations. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team. Work closely with cross-functional teams such as People, Finance, Commercial, and Product to align on strategies and deliverables. Identify and implement process improvements and best practices to enhance efficiency and rider satisfaction. Drive automation and technology-enabled initiatives to improve visibility and performance management. Oversee equipment management including uniforms, delivery boxes, and e-bikes to ensure consistent quality and operational standards. Ensure adherence to performance KPIs such as supply run rate, rider churn and retention, 3PL compliance, rider NPS, EPH, and operational coverage. Build long-term plans to sustain growth and strengthen Talabat’s market leadership position. Qualifications WHAT DID WE ORDER? Bachelor’s degree required, with a preference for majors in Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations, or equivalent work experience in compliance or auditing Minimum of 5 years of experience in operational roles within fast-paced environments. Track record in the FoodTech logistics sector is a plus. Management consulting experience is also considered a significant advantage Management experience is advantageous, with the ability to effectively manage direct reports and foster a strong team culture. Strong problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to dig into detail, manage complexity, and drive decision-making Advanced proficiency in GSheet, demonstrating a strong analytical skill set. Ability to reason analytically, logically, and in a consistent fashion Strong English written and verbal communication skills, capable of engaging across a diverse set of stakeholders, Arabic is good to have but not necessary Extremely organized and process-driven, with a proven ability to manage a heavy workload effectively by setting priorities and managing expectations well Able to travel to all talabat markets as needed.

results.title: Team Leader , Logistics
results.description: About noon We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East—fast, scalable, and deeply customer-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, and we’re looking for a Team Leader, Logistics who can help us move even faster. Noon’s fastest hyper-local delivery platform, Noon Minutes, offers a localised assortment of FMCG & grocery products with delivery within 15 minutes. Currently live across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, offering thousands of products to customers in record time. noon’s mission: Every door, every day. What you’ll do: Effectively manage the assigned fleet across 3-5 Dark Stores within the cluster, consistently meeting target KPIs. Supervise Fleet Managers, overseeing daily operations to ensure the smooth and efficient execution of fleet activities. Ensure rigorous adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and compliance with all operational standards. Support efficient manpower allocation across all stores in the cluster Mentor and guide the team, fostering high performance and proactively addressing operational challenges. Maintain clear, timely, and effective communication with all stakeholders to ensure complete operational alignment. What you’ll need: Minimum 2 years of experience in Logistics, managing teams. Excellent communication and coordination skills. A hands-on approach—willing to roll up your sleeves and get involved. Comfortable working in highly ambiguous situations and adapting to change. Understanding of logistics metrics and ability to manage stakeholders effectively. Flexibility in work schedule to accommodate operational needs. Who will excel? We’re looking for people with high standards who understand that hard work matters. You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action. We need people with the courage to be fiercely original. noon is not for everyone; readiness to adapt, pivot, and learn is essential.

results.title: Fleet, Maintenance & Yard Manager
results.description: Lead fleet, workshop maintenance and yard operations to keep the transport fleet safe, compliant and available. Convert operating plans into preventive and corrective maintenance, spare-parts, tyre, fuel and telematics control, and a safe, well-run yard. Govern uptime, cost, safety and asset lifecycle to protect service reliability and margin. Responsibilities Manage in-house workshop and external repair vendors: labor, parts, turnaround time and repair quality. Own spare-parts inventory, tyre management program and warranty claims. Track vehicle downtime, defect rates and repeat-failure root causes; drive corrective actions. Control fuel consumption, card issuance, reconciliation and anti-theft/leakage controls. Manage the GPS/telematics platform: driver behavior, idling, speed and route-compliance monitoring. Ensure compliance with traffic, transport and HSSE regulations; manage permits, inspections and incident reporting. Oversee yard layout, parking, staging, security and traffic flow for trucks and trailers. Coordinate yard safety controls, signage, lighting and housekeeping standards. Manage yard staff scheduling, gate-in/gate-out procedures and in-yard asset tracking. Own the fleet and maintenance operating budget; track cost per km/vehicle and variance to plan. Produce fleet KPI dashboards covering downtime, availability, maintenance cost and safety incidents. Qualifications & Competencies Bachelor’s degree in mechanical/automotive engineering, Logistics or a related field More than 5 years of experience Relevant experience in fleet, workshop or heavy-vehicle maintenance management Knowledge of preventive maintenance systems, fleet management software and telematics platforms Understanding of traffic, transport and HSSE regulatory requirements Vendor and contract management capability Budget planning and cost-control skills Strong problem-solving, root-cause analysis and hands-on leadership Effective communication with drivers, workshop teams and cross-functional stakeholders

results.title: Logistics & Mobility Director
results.description: MARAFID is the execution arm of Riyadh Holding Company, specializing in the development and activation of economic infrastructure across three core sectors: Logistics & Mobility, Industrial Clusters, and Circular Economy. We bring together development, asset management, leasing, and strategic partnerships to translate these sectors into projects and services that support business activity and serve the needs of operators, tenants, and investors. Our focus spans logistics parks, truck stations, parking facilities, specialized industrial hubs, and infrastructure for material aggregation, reuse, and recycling. Digital solutions and shared services support the management of these assets and their connections with the businesses they serve. Through collaboration with public and private sector partners, MARAFID connects land, infrastructure, and operational expertise to support Riyadh’s economic growth. We are currently seeking a Logistics & Mobility Director to manage and coordinate MARAFID’s logistics and mobility ecosystem operations, overseeing sector assets, services, and ecosystem participants to ensure effective service delivery, operational performance, and sustainable growth of the sector. 1. Key Responsibilities Oversee logistics and mobility ecosystem operations, coordinating activities across MARAFID’s relevant assets, facilities, services, and sector initiatives. Manage the operational performance of sector assets and services, monitoring utilization, service levels, revenues, costs, and other key operational indicators. Coordinate with operators, tenants, service providers, and ecosystem partners to ensure effective integration and delivery of services across the logistics and mobility ecosystem. Identify and implement operational improvement opportunities to enhance asset utilization, service quality, efficiency, customer experience, and overall ecosystem performance. Support the launch and operationalization of new logistics and mobility offerings, ensuring the effective transition of new projects and services into ongoing operations. Monitor sector demand, customer needs, and operational trends to identify opportunities to enhance existing services and inform future ecosystem development. Coordinate with relevant corporate functions to support effective and compliant operations. 2. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field. 7+ years of relevant experience in logistics, mobility, operations, asset management, service delivery, or a related field. Strong understanding of operational performance, service delivery, asset utilization, and key operational indicators. Strong stakeholder management, coordination, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Fluency in Arabic and English.

results.title: Head of Freight Forwarding, Shipping & Customs
results.description: Own and grow FLOW's freight forwarding and shipping business across sea, air and multimodal trade lanes—leading commercial performance, carrier and agency relationships, and operational execution to deliver profitable, reliable freight services. Responsibilities Lead P&L for sea, air, multimodal forwarding and shipping / liner-agency operations. Set commercial strategy for trade lanes, pricing and carrier contracts. Drive volume and margin growth across key accounts and target verticals. Build relationships with shipping lines, airlines, NVOCCs and customs partners. Ensure booking, documentation, customs clearance and on-time delivery excellence. Manage and develop the freight forwarding and shipping team across FLOW's markets. Qualifications & Competencies Bachelor’s degree in business, Logistics or a related field 10+ years in freight forwarding / shipping, including leadership roles Strong carrier, agency and regulator network in KSA / GCC Proven P&L ownership and commercial negotiation track record

results.title: Logistics Director
results.description: 📢 WE’RE HIRING: LOGISTICS DIRECTOR 🕒 Employment Type: Full-Time 💼 Level: Director / Senior Executive Leadership We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Logistics Director to oversee logistics operations, transportation, warehousing, and distribution. The ideal candidate will optimize supply chain efficiency, control operational costs, improve delivery performance, and ensure logistics activities support the organization's business objectives. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement logistics strategies aligned with business goals. Oversee transportation, warehousing, distribution, freight management, and order fulfillment. Optimize delivery routes, warehouse capacity, and logistics processes to reduce costs and improve efficiency. Manage logistics budgets, resources, and operational performance. Lead and develop logistics teams to achieve operational targets. Manage relationships with suppliers, freight forwarders, transport providers, and third-party logistics partners. Negotiate contracts, freight rates, and service agreements. Monitor logistics KPIs, delivery performance, and service quality. Identify operational risks and implement effective solutions. Ensure compliance with relevant transportation, customs, safety, and import/export regulations. Implement logistics technologies and process improvements to enhance efficiency. Collaborate with senior management and other departments to support business growth. Prepare performance reports and recommend strategies for continuous improvement. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Extensive experience in logistics or supply chain management, including leadership responsibilities. Proven ability to manage logistics operations, budgets, and distribution networks. Strong knowledge of transportation, warehousing, inventory control, and freight management. Excellent leadership, strategic planning, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. Familiarity with logistics systems, ERP platforms, and supply chain technologies. Knowledge of customs procedures and relevant regulatory requirements. Strong communication, organizational, and stakeholder management abilities. Commitment to operational efficiency, cost control, and continuous improvement. What We Offer Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits. Leadership development and career advancement opportunities. A collaborative and professional working environment. Opportunities to lead strategic logistics initiatives and improve operational performance. The chance to contribute to business growth and supply chain excellence. 📩 Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV and application for consideration. Join our team and lead logistics operations that improve efficiency, control costs, and support sustainable business growth. #Hiring #LogisticsDirector #LogisticsManagement #SupplyChainManagement #Transportation #OperationsLeadership #CareerOpportunities

results.title: Head of Operations
results.description: Job Purpose: Responsible to manage, lead and develop strategically-oriented operational platforms that mean to efficient delivery FM and EM services in the regional markets, with the objective of prioritizing and optimizing the resulting value from contracted scopes, consistent with the strategy of the client organizations and within the resource capabilities required for that. To build collaboration and support across managed portfolios to effectively blend a need for formal and structured processes with clients desire to quickly respond to the needs of stakeholders involved. Primly account to the strategic fulfillment of operations within the assigned portfolio of assets/ buildings at Contract Sites in assigned Regions while implementing best supplier and customer relationship management, facilities management, building energy services management, maintenance, that improve the overall operational efficiency of managed assets, maintain high customer satisfaction, and help achieve business objectives. Duties & Responsibilities: Operations & Facilities Management Monitor SLAs for the portfolio of assets, and ensure that they are aligned to service delivery, customer expectations, and expectations from suppliers / service partners in order to achieve quality service delivery, effective supplier relationship management, and profitability. Monitor service delivery performance and participate in the evaluation of suppliers’ performance for Sites in the assigned Regions to ensure the selection of appropriately qualified service providers/ contractors at the optimum price in order to deliver the expected quality of service. Monitor resource utilization for Site Operations in the assigned Regions to ensure that the right number and talent is available for running operations (civil works, mechanical works, electrical works, landscaping, building inspections, etc.), accomplishing targets, improving customer satisfaction, and achieving business objectives. Monitor and control the execution of maintenance contracts, review the preventive and corrective maintenance programs, and supervise the implementation by employees or assigned contractor(s) through reviewing reports and spot-checking as appropriate to ensure the provision of quality maintenance works to the assets/ facilities (including maintenance to BMS, chillers, generators, HVAC, IT, etc.). Monitor the process of quotation requests, and the preparation of Purchase Orders and Vendor Contracts, approve same, and ensure that the purchasing process is optimized to guarantee the provision of products/ services to the company/ customer on time and avoid any operational delays. Ensure that the Annual Leave Planer is completed to have a holistic view on forecasted leaves and employees’ availabilities throughout the year so as to guarantee that the appropriate resourcing is done and that business operations do not get interrupted. Leadership Participate and recommend actions to maximize the effective achievement of the Site Contract’s objectives through leading the Site Operations team in the assigned Regions, by setting individual objectives, managing performance, developing and motivating staff, and providing formal and informal feedback and appraisals in order to maximize the subordinates’ and the business unit’s performance. Organization Structure Contribute and assist the Country Director in defining an optimum structure for the division so that resources are optimally utilized and communication takes place in an efficient manner. Budgets & Plans Participate in the budgeting process for the Site Operations business unit and monitor financial performance versus the budget so that the business is aware of anticipated costs/ revenues, areas of unsatisfactory performance and potential areas of cost reduction are identified, and performance improvement opportunities are realized. Lead and manage Sites in the assigned Regional Operations departments while ensuring the planning and allocation of all resources, and the implementation of the appropriate standards and controls to ensure that all activities are carried out in an efficient and effective manner to meet and exceed objectives. Discuss “Site-Specific-Budgets” with customers including CAPEX for example, advise the customers on expenditures, opportunities for cost reductions, and the viability/ feasibility of changing/ buying assets (such as changing a chiller for example) to ensure customers’ budgeting is as appropriate and as accurate as possible. Qualifications: 15+ years’ experience in operations management including 5 years in a managerial role Exposure to Maintenance and Facilities Management especially in the areas of operations planning, HSEEQ, supplier relations management, client relations management, maintenance, and contract management
